name: Open Redirect & Flow Chaining Engine
description: High-impact Open Redirect vulnerability discovery and attack-flow chaining engine. Evaluates parameter-based URL redirects (url=, redirect=, next=, return_to=) across 20+ filter bypass techniques (//, /\, @, %2f%2f, scheme confusion) and automatically determines exploitability for OAuth authorization code leakage and SSRF gateway bypass.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

test_filter_bypasses.description: Test prefix, slash, backslash, and userinfo (@) parser confusion bypasses

test_oauth_chaining.description: Analyze if the redirection endpoint can be chained into OAuth redirect_uri parameters

test_header_redirects.description: Evaluate redirects triggered by client-controllable request headers (X-Forwarded-Host)
